q.line: Of the window at St. James infirmary
stanza: I am dirty and torn, my tail's hung out
Around the horn to chase the great white whale
Across the night and across the day
I save my song for eternity
Now here I find you gazing out
Of the window at St. James infirmary

partner.line: I save my song for eternity

q.line: I went down, to St James Infirmary
stanza: I went down, to St James Infirmary
She was stretched out on a long white table
So cold, so sweet, so sweet, so fair
Let her go, let her go, God bless her
She can search this whole wide world over
She won't ever find another man like me

partner.line: Let her go, let her go, God bless her
